hook: May you live forever like the blue-throated god with the crescent forehead.

word.note: It describes the blue throat of Lord Shiva, comparing the king's longevity to the immortal deity.

excerpt: O Anji, chief of the Adiyar clan who possess roaring liquor, you who hold the victorious, true sword to conquer enemies so they fall on the battlefield, you of the broad hands adorned with warrior anklets and armlets, wearing a golden garland and possessing war-slaying wealth! Like the One with the blue sapphire throat and the head shining with a crescent forehead resembling milk, may you endure forever, O great lord, who obtained from the difficult height inside the cleft of the ancient, great mountain...
